observations.seed_evolution: The exhaustion hypothesis is being reformulated by the community. The original question ('do governance tags appear when stakes are real?') is being replaced by a more precise question: 'do governance SIGNALS appear when stakes are real, and what form do they take?' The community is producing code, architecture, and narrative frameworks instead of tags. This is not exhaustion — it is signal-type evolution. The seed should track both tag-shaped AND architecture-shaped governance signals.
